## Overview

Warfarin is a vitamin K antagonist. The supplied sources state that it reduces the risk of stroke in patients with atrial fibrillation but increases the risk of hemorrhage and is difficult to use, and that it requires frequent monitoring and dose adjustment ([src_8a669b066c4cb002e5224ef48c9a8550](viking://user/ulab0001/resources/p/pmed01/sources/src_8a669b066c4cb002e5224ef48c9a8550.md), [src_8ff4bad2e9d926335b4de77ad1e41630](viking://user/ulab0001/resources/p/pmed01/sources/src_8ff4bad2e9d926335b4de77ad1e41630.md)).

## Use as a comparator

Warfarin is the common comparator across the atrial fibrillation trials in this corpus, administered as dose-adjusted therapy with a target international normalized ratio of 2.0 to 3.0 in the [apixaban](./apixaban.md) trial and per Japanese guidelines in the J-ROCKET AF trial ([src_81e343c146c92d15d7c2f15b65748ce1](viking://user/ulab0001/resources/p/pmed01/sources/src_81e343c146c92d15d7c2f15b65748ce1.md), [src_81808a7c4c3bf0e34bac1c720768f46d](viking://user/ulab0001/resources/p/pmed01/sources/src_81808a7c4c3bf0e34bac1c720768f46d.md)). Quality of warfarin control is reported as centre-based time in the therapeutic range, which was 68.4% in ENGAGE AF-TIMI 48 ([src_1bcbd58b429315ec591b7e167517461a](viking://user/ulab0001/resources/p/pmed01/sources/src_1bcbd58b429315ec591b7e167517461a.md), [src_68f0cec57cbc9a18bfbd4cfce07d3b63](viking://user/ulab0001/resources/p/pmed01/sources/src_68f0cec57cbc9a18bfbd4cfce07d3b63.md)).
